verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents that its notetaker can autojoin your calendar meetings and automatically record Google Meet calls, which covers the core of calendar-driven automatic capture. It does not document a one-time Google or Outlook calendar connection, or any per-meeting-type capture rules. The 'Rules Engine' is described only as controlling meeting access and privacy, a different control, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: documented Google/Outlook calendar connection flow, per-meeting-type auto-capture rules (e.g., internal vs external, by title or attendee), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I connect Google or Outlook calendar once and control per-meeting-type rules for which meetings get captured automatically

citations.quote: have it autojoin your calendar meetings to record, transcribe, and summarize
